voices coming from the tech industry.

the transitional moment has the

about productivity benefits that they
were seeing. Cisco talked about projects
that had been too tedious to even

General Secretary of the
20-million-member-strong UNI Global

doing more with fewer workers."

60% of jobs in advanced economies and
40% globally. Now, I remember a study

assume that's what she's talking about.

enhanced by AI, and the people in these

big concerns.

increasing barriers to youth employment
